modal.title: Create API Key
modal.description: API keys let other programs and devices use FixFlow: send it sensor readings, read your work orders and assets, or change them.

scopes.title: What this key may do
scopes.iot_hint: For gateways and sensors that send readings to FixFlow.
scopes.read: Read work orders, assets, locations and parts
scopes.read_hint: For dashboards and other programs that only look. They use the public API.
scopes.write: Also create and change work orders and assets
scopes.write_hint: For programs that make work orders and move them along. Includes reading.
scopes.required: Choose at least one thing the key may do.
scopes.write_warning: Anyone with this key can change work orders and assets. Keep it secret.

reveal.check_hint: Run this to check that the key works. It answers with the key's name and what it may do.
reveal.send_hint: Send the key in the Authorization header, or in an X-API-Key header. Never in the address.

webhooks.title: Webhooks have their own page
webhooks.body: Webhooks are messages FixFlow sends to other systems when something happens, such as a work order being completed. Set them up under Settings, Webhooks.
webhooks.keys_note: Programs that read or change data in FixFlow, such as n8n or Zapier calling it, use API keys with the read or write scope. Make one on the API Keys tab.
